svg.title: AstralBeam wordmark
svg.desc: AstralBeam wordmark in a light, slightly tightened sans-serif style.
svg.metadata: AstralBeam wordmark construction: - Reusable id: #astralbeam-wordmark. - Open-source typeface: Montserrat. - Letter spacing tightened from 9 to 6 to pair with the clearer monogram.
